DISPOSITION.statement: this is a descriptive screen of a slip the owner constructed. It is not a recommendation, not an authorization, and nothing here was placed.

PARLAY_TAX_CHECK.verdict: NO incremental parlay hold — the payout is marginally better than the exact product of the three legs' own vig. A point in the slip's favour.

compression_reexpansion.note: NYM sits above 50% so re-expansion HELPS it; KC sits below so it hurts. They partly cancel, which is why the parlay is more robust to compression than the raw candidate ranking was.

correlated_direction_bias.observation: all three legs are the plus/underdog side — NYM +101, KC +121, POR +12.5
correlated_direction_bias.why_it_matters: a compressed model is biased the SAME WAY on every dog, so these three leg errors are correlated in direction rather than independent, and a parlay multiplies them

SENSITIVITY.reading: the slip stays +EV while POR's true cover probability exceeds 45.38%

STRUCTURE.reading: the parlay is higher EV and far higher variance. Its EV depends multiplicatively on the least-verified number in the whole calculation.

TIMEZONE_ITEM_ADVANCED.finding: under Pacific the two MLB slots match the frozen board EXACTLY (4:10 PM PT = 7:10 PM ET = 23:10Z) while POR@ATL is +10 minutes. So the open discrepancy is NOT a timezone error and NOT a global book offset — it is specific to the WNBA parquet.
